name: westwood_online_upgrade_download_event_sink_state_changed
description: WestwoodOnlineUpgradeDownloadEventSink::OnStateChanged maps WOL download state codes to progress dialog status strings.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
The wider download event-sink vtable is still under reconstruction; this target verifies the callback body directly.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja disassembly and stack variables for 0x442720 validate a two-argument stdcall callback. It ignores self, maps state code 2 to "Connecting...", 4 to "Finding patch...", 6 to "Downloading patch...", leaves other states without a status update, returns S_OK in eax, and pops two stack arguments.

Native smoke westwood_online_upgrade_download_event_sink_state_changed_smoke patches USER32 SetDlgItemTextA through the real SetStatusTextFmt path, then verifies all three mapped state strings, the ignored state, progress HWND, control id 1023, global status buffer pointer, and S_OK returns.
